events.info: All AgesGeneral Admission General Admission is standing-room only. __________________________________________________ Reserved Table Seating Upgrade your experience with one of our exclusive bar-height tables for two. Availability is limited to 15 tables per show, and Reserved Table tickets must be purchased as a pair. Reserved Table tickets include: Two (2) General Admission tickets A private bar-height table for two Full access to the Off The Rails food menu Dedicated table service for food and beverage orders One (1) complimentary parking space per table (please present your Reserved Table ticket to the parking attendant upon arrival) For ticketing questions or ADA accommodations, please contact us at info@offtherailsworcester.com. ______________________________________________________ Important Information Please note: Restaurant reservations made through TOAST are not valid event tickets and do not include admission to the music venue. Restaurant seating does not provide views of the stage or access to ticketed performances. If you plan to attend a ticketed event, you must purchase an event ticket separately, regardless of any restaurant reservation made through TOAST. Reserved Table tickets purchased through our ticketing platform are the only table reservations that include admission to the performance and seating inside the music venue.

events.name: Worcester Railers vs. Wheeling Nailers - Railers Fight Cancer
events.info: Before the Railers take the ice, fans will have the opportunity to watch the Why Me All-Stars face off against Bruins Alumni in a special pregame exhibition featuring Bruins legends and local heroes raising money for Why Me. Admission to the pregame game is included with every Railers game ticket. Throughout the evening, the Railers will recognize individuals who have battled or are currently battling cancer. These special in-game moments will shine a spotlight on stories of strength, courage, and resilience in support of those impacted by the disease. The Railers will also wear specialty Fight Cancer jerseys during the game, which will be available for fans to bid on during our specialty jersey auction. All proceeds from the jersey auction will directly benefit Why Me & Sherry's House and their mission of providing support and resources to children and families facing cancer throughout Central Massachusetts.

The purchase or use of these seating locations by non-disabled individuals is strictly prohibited and may result in ejection and/or forfeiture of ticket price. 1) Order online at Ticketmaster.com

2) Call the DCU Center Box Office (508) 929-0164

3) Call Ticketmaster at (800) 745-3000

4) Visit the DCU Center Arena Box Office - 50 Foster St., Worcester, MA 01608

5) Visit Ticketmaster Outlets

events.name: The Rock Orchestra: Arena of Fire
events.info: After back to back tours around the world, The Rock Orchestra returns to the USA with a brand new show! Igniting the flames of legendary Rock & Metal songs with the help of pyro displays and fire performers, The Rock Orchestra presents its epic new spectacle: Arena of Fire. Prepare for a spellbinding 90-minute concert, as 14 classical musicians breath beautifully dark energy into iconic songs. Performing the music of iconic bands including: Metallica, AC/DC, Rolling Stones, My Chemical Romance, Linkin' Park, SOAD, Guns N Roses, Evanescence, Papa Roach, The Cranberries & MORE! Witness the electrifying fusion of Classical music and Metal in a show that burns with beauty & intensity. The Rock Orchestra is a rotating collective of classical musicians that features some of the world's greatest instrumentalists and vocalists Disclaimer: The Rock Orchestra and its events are not affiliated with the artists and composers listed. All trademarks are the property of their respective owner
